statements.status_notes: The pkgconf 2.5.1 release shipped in this image does not contain the bytecode handling that GHSA-fr7f-m8jv-4qcm affects. The advisory limits the affected versions to those after 2.9.50 and before 3.0.11, which excludes 2.5.1. Advisory: https://github.com/pkgconf/pkgconf/security/advisories/GHSA-fr7f-m8jv-4qcm

The DHI pkgconf APK backports the upstream fix for GHSA-qcp5-98c5-hvh7. After the fix, a dependency named in a pc(5) file is looked up as a module name and is never opened as a path, so a .pc file cannot make pkgconf read an arbitrary file or recurse into itself. Advisory: https://github.com/pkgconf/pkgconf/security/advisories/GHSA-qcp5-98c5-hvh7
